title: Create Haven Modpack
description: Have fun with your friends in this amazing adventure and automation based modpack! Make crazy contraptions and cool shops!
body:
Welcome to **Create Haven**! 🌍✨

Dive into an immersive Minecraft experience with our **Create-based gameplay** that emphasizes creativity and automation. Our server features the **TACZ automation** mod, along with a variety of renewable resources to enhance your gameplay.

### Key Features:

*   **Innovative Automation**: Experience custom CraftTweaks designed to prioritize automation, making your builds more efficient and fun!
*   **Community Focused**: Join a friendly community of players who share your passion for creativity and automation.
